name: 等离子传导
desc: [烈焰雷电]对受[灼烧]影响的敌人造成的伤害提高 +{burningDamage}，敌人身上每层[静电]使造成的伤害提高 +{electrostaticDamage}。敌人同时拥有两种效果时两个加成均生效。
descEn: [Flame Lightning] deals +{burningDamage} damage to enemies affected by [Burn] and +{electrostaticDamage} damage per stack of [Electrostatic] on the enemy. Both bonuses apply when the enemy has both effects.

name: 冰霜光束扩展
desc: [冰霜光束]的长度和宽度提高 {value}。
descEn: [Frost Beam]'s length and width are increased by {value}.

name: 冰霜蓄能
desc: 施放[冰霜新星]时有 {chance} 几率恢复 {value} 点法力值。
descEn: Casting [Ice Nova] has a {chance} chance to restore {value} Mana.

name: 元素狂怒
desc: [火元素]的攻击速度提高 {value}。
descEn: [Fire Elemental] attacks {value} faster.

name: 寒冰复苏
desc: [寒冰屏障]期间，每秒恢复最大生命值的 {value}。
descEn: Restore {value} of your maximum Health every second during [Ice Block].

name: 天灾
desc: [火陨石]造成 +{damage} 伤害，但冷却时间延长 {cooldown}。
descEn: [Fire Meteor] deals +{damage} Damage but has a {cooldown} longer Cooldown.

name: 烈焰守护
desc: [烈焰光环]激活期间，护甲和魔法抗性提高 {value}。
descEn: While [Flame Aura] is active, gain +{value} Armor and Magic Resist.

name: 持久雷云
desc: [雷云]的地面效果持续时间延长 {value}。
descEn: [Lightning Cloud]'s ground effect lasts {value} longer.

name: 永冻
desc: 你施加的[冰冻]持续时间延长 {duration}。
descEn: [Frozen] applied by you lasts {duration} longer.

name: 奥术暴露
desc: 每施放 {casts} 次[强力攻击]，就会对命中的目标施加[易伤]。
descEn: Every {casts} casts of [Strong Attack] apply [Vulnerable] to targets hit.

name: 奥术储能
desc: 你的最大法力值的 {value} 会加成到智力。
descEn: {value} of your Max Mana is added to Intelligence.

name: 奥术动能
desc: 施放[特殊]技能会使[普通攻击]伤害提高 {value}，持续 {duration}。
descEn: Casting a [Special] Ability increases [Basic Attack] damage by {value} for {duration}.

name: 电流传导
desc: 受[静电]影响的敌人死亡时，有 {chance} 几率对 {radius} 范围内的敌人施加[静电]。
descEn: When an enemy affected by [Electrostatic] dies, it has a {chance} chance to apply [Electrostatic] to enemies within {radius}.

name: 风暴精通
desc: [闪电]技能获得 +{critDamage} 暴击伤害，并获得 +{resistance} 闪电伤害减免。
descEn: Gain +{critDamage} Critical Hit Damage to [Lightning] Abilities and +{resistance} Lightning Damage Reduction.

name: 力量
desc: +{value} 力量
descEn: +{value} Strength

name: 活力
desc: +{value} 最大生命值与 +{regen} 生命恢复
descEn: +{value} Max HP and +{regen} Life Regen

name: 护甲
desc: +{value1} 护甲，+{value2} 魔法抗性
descEn: +{value1} Armor and +{value2} Magic Resist

name: 迎击
desc: 附近有至少3名存活敌人时，受到的伤害降低 {value}。
descEn: Take {value} less damage while at least 3 living enemies are nearby.

name: 暴击几率
desc: +{value} 暴击几率
descEn: +{value} Critical Hit Chance

name: 暴击伤害
desc: +{value} 暴击伤害
descEn: +{value} Critical Hit Damage

name: 荆棘
desc: +{value} 荆棘
descEn: +{value} Thorn

name: 生命恢复
desc: +{value} 生命恢复
descEn: +{value} Life Regen

name: 挫志怒吼
desc: 施放[战吼]时，使附近敌人造成的伤害降低 {value}，持续 {duration}。
descEn: Casting a [Warcry] reduces nearby enemies’ damage dealt by {value} for {duration}.

name: 弱点掌握
desc: +{value} 对易伤目标的伤害
descEn: +{value} Damage to Vulnerable targets

name: 劈砍狂怒
desc: 释放 [普通攻击] 技能后，每层 +{value} 攻击速度，最多叠加10层。
descEn: Casting a [Basic Attack] ability grants +{value} Attack Speed per stack (up to 10 stacks).

name: 战斗激励
desc: 施放[战吼]时，使另一个[特殊]技能的剩余冷却减少 {value} 秒。
descEn: Casting a [Warcry] reduces the other [Special] ability’s remaining cooldown by {value} second.

name: 重击
desc: [强力攻击]的直接伤害暴击命中敌人时，使其陷入[易伤]，持续 {duration}。
descEn: [Strong Attack] direct critical hits inflict [Vulnerable] for {duration}.

name: 荆棘强化
desc: +{value} 荆棘
descEn: +{value} Thorn

name: 强化强力攻击：法力
desc: +{value} [强力攻击] 法力消耗减少。
descEn: +{value} [Strong Attack] Mana Cost reduction.

name: 怒火注入
desc: +{strongAttackDamage} [强力攻击] 伤害，但也 +{strongAttackManaCost} 法力消耗。
descEn: +{strongAttackDamage} [Strong Attack] Damage, but also +{strongAttackManaCost} Mana Cost.

name: 强化战吼：冷却
desc: +{value} [战吼] 技能冷却缩减。
descEn: +{value} [Warcry] Abilities Cooldown reduction.

name: 怒火导引
desc: 激活狂怒护盾时生成 {value} 法力
descEn: Generate {value} Mana upon activating Rage Shield

name: [野兽] 奴隶强化
desc: 出战的 [野兽] 提供 {value} 力量提升。
descEn: Active [Beast] provides {value} Strength increase.

name: [人形] 奴隶强化
desc: 出战的 [人形] 提供 {value} 对精英敌人的伤害。
descEn: Active [Humanoid] provides {value} Damage vs Elite.

name: 防御姿态
desc: +{value} 护甲
descEn: +{value} Armor

name: 重整旗鼓
desc: 当生命值低于最大生命值的50%时回复 {value}。（冷却6秒）
descEn: Heal {value} when HP drop below 50% Max HP. (6 seconds cooldown)

name: 震荡打击
desc: [普通攻击] 有 {stunChance} 几率眩晕敌人。
descEn: [Basic Attack] have {stunChance} to stun the enemy.

name: 乘胜追击
desc: +{value} 对眩晕目标的伤害
descEn: +{value} Damage on Stunned targets.

name: 蔓延烈焰
desc: 烈焰斩会对周围敌人溅射 {splash} 武器伤害作为火焰伤害。
descEn: Flame Strike splashes {splash} weapon damage as Fire to nearby enemies.

name: 强化英勇打击：法力获取
desc: 英勇打击 +{value} 法力获取。
descEn: +{value} Mana Gain from Valiant Strike.

name: [不死族] 奴隶强化
desc: 出战的 [不死族] 提供 {value} 暴击伤害。
descEn: Active [Undead] provides {value} Critical Hit Damage.

name: 凶狠荆棘
desc: 荆棘可以触发暴击。
descEn: Thorn can trigger Critical Hit.

name: 溢血
desc: 你击杀流血敌人时，将其剩余流血伤害的 {value} 作为物理血爆，伤害 {radius} 米内的其他敌人。
descEn: When you kill a Bleeding enemy, deal {value} of its remaining Bleed damage as a Physical blood explosion to other enemies within {radius} meters.

name: 放血
desc: +{value} [流血] 技能伤害。
descEn: +{value} [Bleed] Ability Damage.

name: 怒吼强化
desc: 怒吼的攻击速度加成提升 {value}，并延长 {duration}。
descEn: Rage Shout's Attack Speed bonus is {value} stronger and lasts {duration} longer.

name: 弦月收割
desc: 半月斩造成的伤害 +{damage}。 半月斩击杀敌人时恢复 {mana} 最大法力值。
descEn: Half Moon Slash deals +{damage} Damage. Each enemy killed by Half Moon Slash restores {mana} of your Max Mana.

name: 蓄势待发
desc: 普攻击中获得蓄势，达到 {stacks} 层后获得所有伤害 +{damage}，持续 {duration}。
descEn: Basic Attack hits grant a charge. At {stacks} charges, gain +{damage} to all damage for {duration}.

name: 铁壁护盾
desc: 每次普攻击中获得 {shield} 最大生命的护盾，持续 {duration}。
descEn: Each Basic Attack hit adds a shield equal to {shield} of your Max HP for {duration}.

name: 巅峰状态
desc: 生命值高于80%时，全部伤害 +{value}。
descEn: +{value} All Damage while you are Healthy (above 80% HP).

name: 深化创伤
desc: [流血]技能命中生命值低于 {threshold} 的非首领敌人时，有 {value} 几率将其斩杀。
descEn: [Bleed] Ability hits have a {value} chance to execute non-Boss enemies below {threshold} HP.

name: 强化英勇打击：易伤几率
desc: 英勇打击额外获得 {value} 几率造成 [易伤]。
descEn: Valiant Strike has an additional {value} chance to inflict [Vulnerable].

name: 怒火回流
desc: 每次承受敌人的直接命中时，恢复 {mana} 最大法力。
descEn: Each direct enemy hit restores {mana} of your Max Mana.

name: 屠夫韵律
desc: 裂血连击额外劈砍 {value} 次。
descEn: Rending Onslaught carves {value} additional cuts.

name: 专注武技
desc: [普通攻击]伤害 +{damage}，普攻获得的法力 −{manaGain}。
descEn: [Basic Attack] damage +{damage}, but Mana gained from Basic Attacks −{manaGain}.

name: 内焰熔炉
desc: 每秒消耗 {mana} 最大法力，获得[强力攻击]伤害 +{damage}，技能法力消耗降低 {costReduction}。
descEn: Consumes {mana} of your Max Mana each second to gain +{damage} [Strong Attack] damage and {costReduction} reduced ability Mana cost.

name: 嗜血
desc: 当敌人在流血状态下死亡，或被 [流血] 技能击杀时，获得一层 [嗜血]，持续 {duration}，每层提升 {value} 伤害，最多叠加10层。
descEn: When an enemy dies while Bleeding, or is slain by a [Bleed] Ability, gain a stack of [Bloodlust] for {duration}, increasing your Damage by {value} per stack, up to 10 stacks.

name: 反攻风暴
desc: 每承受 {hits} 次敌人直接命中，向附近敌人释放反击，造成 {damage} 武器伤害的物理伤害。
descEn: After every {hits} direct enemy hits, counterattack nearby enemies for {damage} weapon damage as Physical damage.

name: 铁血
desc: 你的最大生命值的 {value} 会加成到荆棘。
descEn: {value} of your Max HP is added to your Thorn.

name: 死神之刃
desc: 旋风斩的攻击与旋转速度提升 {value}。引导旋风斩期间，移动速度提高 {movement}。
descEn: Whirlwind strikes and spins {value} faster. +{movement} Movement Speed while channeling Whirlwind.
